appearance: Dry night race; qualifying and introductions also include twilight.

origin.meaning: Local source origin at the point on the loop nearest the venue coordinate, after rotation to the start.

native_station_frame.side_convention: Driver left/right in forward lap direction; geographic footprints retain source east/north coordinates.

review.method: Viewed every frame of overview and detail contact sheets. Sparse review of edited gameplay; rear cameras, menus and cuts are excluded as metric geometry evidence.

sectors.name: Pit straight and T1–3
sectors.observed: Left main grandstand and first-turn stand; right long white pit/hospitality and Sakhir Tower. Red-white kerbs, broad coloured paved T1 escape, sand beyond. Keep braking 150/100/50 boards before T1 and protection behind runoff.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T3 climb, first back straight and T4
sectors.observed: University stands outside opening sequence, sandy banks, fenced dry infield. Broad outer asphalt at T4, narrow inner red-white kerb, green and blue painted shoulders. Floodlight heads remain visible above the horizon.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T5–8 linked infield bends
sectors.observed: Low fast left/right sequence descends through open sand; short grass/painted strips immediately outside red-white kerbs, larger coloured asphalt where a car continues straight. Avoid uniform gravel strips around every bend.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T9–10 downhill left braking
sectors.observed: Slow left apex below approach; large tan/sandy outside with coloured asphalt bordering road. Low barriers set back behind escape area, bright vertical light poles; few distant palms.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Inner straight and T11
sectors.observed: Batelco spectator structure is right of inner straight near station2790. Straight Armco/mesh protection, beige dry expanse, asphalt escape at left-hand entry. Keep stand geometry above wall visible.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: T12–13 fast right rise
sectors.observed: Open rising sandy ground, red-white inside kerb and coloured paved outside transition. Track floodlighting, low guardrail/tyre backing rather than roadside buildings on both sides.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Back straight and final right T14–15
sectors.observed: Long open straight toward white pointed canopy cluster; Victory stands outside final bend. Red-white apex, wide dark/blue-green escape with sand behind; lamps on both sides. Preserve long braking sightline.
sectors.registration: Approximate sector association from road shape, map and landmarks, not linear playback time. Bounds are authoring intervals, not surveyed corner boundaries.

sectors.name: Final exit and pit approach
sectors.observed: Mainstand left, pit hospitality right, slim green verge adjoining road; repeated white roofs and lit fences dominate return. Continuous ground contact at pit wall; no misplaced blocks in driving lane.
